summary.text: Jessica Blanchard is the Democratic candidate for the Maine House of Representatives, District 69, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Republican Dean Cray.
A nonprofit professional and the director of training at Good Will-Hinckley, she also ran for the seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Blanchard earned a bachelor's degree from Eastern Connecticut State University in 2004 and a graduate degree from Southern New Hampshire University in 2018.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, she said she owned a home-based childcare center when her four children were young and later worked in nonprofit and business roles in training and facilitation.
She said she serves as Director of Training at Good Will-Hinckley and lives in Palmyra with her husband.
Blanchard lost the Maine House District 69 general election to Dean Cray in 2024.
In the 2024 survey, she named defending democratic values and reproductive freedom among her key messages.
